model.catLabel: RE50 owner's manual Rev E with parts lists (PDF)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from Tru-Turf's product photo and are approximate; the photo may be a later build than the 2022 rollers. The motor, controller, gearbox, toothed belt drive, drive roller, rear smoothing head, batteries and charger sit under the body and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from the RE50 owner's manual Rev E (rollers up to serial RE50-0401, which covers the 2022 units) and the Tru-Turf Service Kits 2026 list. Both rollers are recorded with serial 1875692/10: read each plate. The RB70 petrol roller (Petrol Roller 1, disabled) is not in this view.

hoop.name: Trailer hoop frame
hoop.desc: Yellow hoop that carries the transport wheels and drawbar when the roller is set up as a trailer. Store the roller in the towing position: it protects the trailer strut shaft. Weekly: look over the frame for cracks and loose bolts. Spring for the steering return and trailer catch is in the annual kit RS2498.

drawbar.name: Drawbar and drawbar catch
drawbar.desc: Main drawbar with the drawbar catch alongside it. Daily before towing: catch locked to the main drawbar with the safety pin fitted, gas strut working and its eyelets tight. Check the gas strut yearly and replace it if it is weak (R5210 on Rev E builds, R5202 gas strut 620 on Rev L builds).

tyreR.name: Transport wheel, right
tyreR.desc: 18 in. 4-stud tyre and wheel R9074. The manual lists the tyre as 18 x 6.50 x 4, 4 ply: check the sidewall before ordering. Pressure 124-165 kPa (18-24 psi), never over 165 kPa (24 psi). Trailer hub: two L44643 bearings (R9030) and one CR 12610 inner seal (R9029) per hub; check bearings and seals at the yearly service.

tyreL.name: Transport wheel, left
tyreL.desc: 18 in. 4-stud tyre and wheel R9074 (manual reads 18 x 6.50 x 4, 4 ply: check the sidewall). 124-165 kPa (18-24 psi), never over 165 kPa (24 psi). Trailer hub bearings L44643 x2 (R9030) and inner seal CR 12610 (R9029) per hub.

body.name: Body and battery compartment cover
body.desc: Red body over the drive unit: 48 V AC motor, AC induction controller, reduction gearbox, toothed belt drive, onboard charger and the battery pack. Monthly: battery connections tight and clean, charger leads sound, belt tension checked. Weekly: look over the whole machine for loose or worn parts. Keep the vents clear.

seat.name: Seat
seat.desc: Operator seat with armrests. Check mounting bolts are tight at the weekly look-over.

joystick.name: Steering joystick
joystick.desc: Steering joystick on the red column. Daily: no looseness in the joystick. Two S6304-2RS stainless bearings (R8018) in the joystick assembly. The catalogue match shown for R8018 looks wrong for a bearing: check the price before ordering.

headlight.name: Headlight
headlight.desc: Front headlight on the body. Check it works as part of the daily look-over.

panel.name: Key switch, battery gauge and hour meter
panel.desc: Key switch with the battery gauge and hour meter. With the key off the gauge and hour meter still draw 0.022 A (0.125 A key on), which slowly drains the pack over a long lay-up: isolate the battery or keep it on charge as the battery maker says. Controller fault codes are listed in the manual's fault-code table (code 23 = under-voltage cutback, charge the batteries).

footplate.name: Footplate and front frame
footplate.desc: Checker-plate footplate on the front frame. Weekly: look over for loose or worn parts. Keep all nuts, bolts and grub screws tight, especially the grub screws on the drive-roller end-bearing lock rings and the smoothing-head pivot bearings.

pedal.name: Foot pedal
pedal.desc: Foot pedal on the footplate. Daily: the pedal must press down under normal foot pressure.

headF.name: Front smoothing head
headF.desc: Smoothing head with three offset rollers: two short R8217 and one long RS2050. Each roller has two 6004-2RS bearings (R8212, 20 x 42 x 12 mm), two end-cap seals (R8409, 20 x 46 x 10 mm) and two 42 mm internal circlips (R8485): 6 of each per head, 12 per machine. Daily (trailer down): spin each roller by hand; tight, rough or loose means new bearings. Monthly: check all six rollers. Renew the bearings every 12 months (annual kit RS2498 includes a smoothing-roller rebuild kit). Use anti-seize on the roller shaft bolts on reassembly and make sure the rollers spin freely when tightened. Keep the heads parallel (adjust the connecting rods if disturbed). Open job on Greens Roller 2 (MCH-4): front steering-roller bearings, order 6 x R8212, 6 x R8409 and 6 x R8485 for the head (or the RS2498 kit).

headR.name: Rear smoothing head
headR.desc: Second smoothing head, same build as the front: two short R8217 rollers and one long RS2050, each with two R8212 bearings, two R8409 seals and two R8485 circlips. Spin-test each roller daily, check monthly, renew bearings every 12 months. Roll from the fringe.

tierod.name: Steering connecting rods and rod ends
tierod.desc: Connecting rods that steer the smoothing heads and keep them parallel; adjust them if the heads are knocked out of line. Rod ends 1/2 in. UNF female R8285 and male R8287. Oil the rod ends sparingly before use. The annual kit RS2498 has 2 x 1/2 in. UNF female and 2 x studded female rod ends.

catch.name: Hitch catch and safety pin
catch.desc: Catch and pin on chain at the front of the frame used when the roller is set up for towing. Daily before towing: catch locked and the safety pin fitted. The trailer catch spring is in the annual kit RS2498.

motor.name: Drive motor, 48 V AC
motor.desc: 48 V AC electric motor, 2500 W (E7196), driving through the reduction gearbox and toothed belt to the drive roller.

controller.name: Motor controller
controller.desc: AC induction controller E7297. Fault codes are in the manual's fault-code table; code 23 (under-voltage cutback) means the batteries need charging.

gearbox.name: Reduction gearbox
gearbox.desc: Gearbox E7039: Falk Ultramite double-reduction helical (Rev E); Rev L names Rexnord 203UCBN2A-8.0A1B. The Tru-Turf manual gives no oil type or change interval: check for leaks monthly and get the oil type and interval from Rexnord before the first oil change.

beltdrive.name: Toothed belt drive
beltdrive.desc: Belt E7074 (8MGT-960-36: 8 mm pitch, 960 mm long, 36 mm wide) on drive sprocket E7072 (8MX-38S-36) and driven sprocket E7073 (8XM-50S-36), part of the Electric Belt Drive RS2205. Monthly: tension to about 6 mm (1/4 in.) deflection midway between the sprockets, idler square to the belt, check belt wear. Use only E7074: wrong-pitch belts look alike and wreck the sprockets. Replace the sprockets with the belt if the teeth are hooked or worn. At 2,100-2,300 h budget for a belt and sprockets.

droller.name: Drive roller
droller.desc: One rubber-coated flex drive roller (Flex Belt Drive Roller E7286) on two SBLF206 bearing units (R5265). Lightly grease the drive-roller bearings before use and refit any missing plastic caps. Check the bearings monthly; renew every 12 months. Keep the grub screws on the end-bearing lock rings tight. The kit bearing units (R5077 housing + R5078 bearing, E7011 housing + R5078) differ from the Rev E list (R5265): confirm the kit suits the serial when ordering.

pivot.name: Pivot beam
pivot.desc: Pivot beam RS2264 carrying the smoothing heads, with two 6206-2RS bearings (R8671). Lightly grease the smoothing-head pivot bearings before use and keep their grub screws tight.

sweepers.name: Nodule sweepers
sweepers.desc: Rubber nodule sweeper rollers keep the smoothing rollers clean (there are no scraper blades). Roller R8461 has 12 nodules: 9 per short sweeper R8468, 10 per long sweeper RS2055.

batteries.name: Battery pack, 48 V
batteries.desc: Rev E builds: lead-acid standard, lithium optional. Lithium option is 4 x RELiON 48 V 30 Ah in parallel (120 Ah). The manual gives no battery model number: read the label on the fitted batteries before ordering (Tru-Turf moved to Trojan lithium on later builds). Charge after use and before going out; no memory, top up any time and avoid running flat. At over 2,000 h expect capacity loss: yearly battery health check per RELiON or Trojan instructions.

charger.name: Onboard charger
charger.desc: Delta-Q IC1200 48 V charger R8705 in the drive unit. Monthly: check the charger leads. Yearly: function check.

strut.name: Trailer gas strut
strut.desc: Gas strut for the trailer set-up: R5210 (Rev E) or R5202 gas strut 620 (Rev L). Daily: strut working and eyelets tight. Replace when weak. Store the roller in the towing position to protect the strut shaft.

hubs.name: Trailer hubs and bearings
hubs.desc: Each hub has two L44643 bearings (R9030) and one CR 12610 inner seal (R9029). Check bearings and seals at the yearly service.

brake.name: Park brake
brake.desc: Daily: the park brake must hold the machine on a push test. If it does not, turn the adjuster knob clockwise.

R5210.name: Trailer strut (Rev E)
R5210.note: Catalogue row reads 'R5210 (Rev E) / R5202 gas strut 620 (Rev L)'. No public AUD price: ask Tru-Turf spare parts.

R5202.name: Gas strut 620 (Rev L builds)
R5202.note: Later builds. Check which strut is fitted.

E7196.name: Drive motor, 48 V AC 2500 W
E7196.note: From the RE50 owner's manual. No public price.

E7297.name: AC induction motor controller
E7297.note: From the RE50 owner's manual. No public price.

E7039.name: Reduction gearbox
E7039.note: Falk Ultramite (Rev E) / Rexnord 203UCBN2A-8.0A1B (Rev L). Oil per Rexnord.

E7286.name: Flex Belt Drive Roller
E7286.note: Rubber-coated drive roller with two SBLF206 bearing units R5265.

RS2264.name: Pivot beam
RS2264.note: Holds two 6206-2RS bearings R8671 (Rev E p.44).

RS2050.name: Smoothing roller complete (long)
RS2050.note: One per head. Short roller is R8217.

RS2205.name: Electric Belt Drive assembly
RS2205.note: Includes belt E7074 and sprockets E7072 / E7073.
